name: Disk Health Warning (SMART)
description: Catches smartd reports of a failing disk: a failed health self-check, a failed attribute, pending or offline uncorrectable sectors, a change in the reallocated or pending sector attributes, and new self-test or ATA errors. Needs smartd running on the host. Disks behind some RAID controllers report nothing to smartd.
match_pattern: FAILED SMART self-check|Failed SMART \w+ Attribute|Currently unreadable \(pending\) sectors|Offline uncorrectable sectors|Prefailure Attribute: (?:5|197|198) \S+ changed from|Self-Test Log error count increased|ATA error count increased
